bagPolicy.summary: FARGODOME encourages guests not to bring bags to events. Bags larger than 13”x13” are not permitted unless medically necessary.
bagPolicy.note: Oversized bags (diaper bags/medical bags) allowed for necessity will be screened and identified with a colored band.

parking.note: Parking lots at Fargodome open approximately 2 hours before events, with general parking costing $5.00 cash. Bus parking is available in lot E for $15.00 cash per bus. All lots close no more than one hour after the event.

rideshare.note: Use the west side of Albrecht Boulevard for Uber, Lyft, taxi, bus, and limousine pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: The Fargodome offers alcoholic beverages with a limit of two per purchase, and sales end at the start of the 4th quarter during NDSU Football games. Alcohol service policies may vary for special events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating can be bought at the FARGODOME ticket office or online at fargodome.com, with up to three companion tickets in the designated accessible areas. If you have a standard ticket and need an accessible seat, the venue will try to move you to a comparable wheelchair-accessible seat, first-come, first-served, with no guarantee.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Most events prohibit re-entry. In an emergency, ask Event Services before leaving. Approved re-entry must use the same entrance.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Generally, will call is located at the main box office, located in the lobby of the east, main entrance of FARGODOME Box office opens a minimum of 2 hours prior to scheduled event time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is on the east side and leads to the Box Office; the north, west, and south entrances open depending on the event. If you use a mobility device or can't go through the walk-through metal detectors, use the accessible entrance, where a hand-held wand is used.
